en.headline: Six injured after truck and minibus collide on Castle Peak Road
en.dek: A heavy goods vehicle and a green minibus collided on the Yuen Long-bound section of Castle Peak Road–Tam Mi near Po Wai around 4.30 pm, leaving six people with neck injuries.
body: Six people were injured on Thursday afternoon when a heavy goods vehicle and a green public light bus collided on the Yuen Long-bound lanes of Castle Peak Road–Tam Mi near Po Wai in Yuen Long.

Police received the report at about 4.30 pm. Fire and ambulance personnel arrived at the scene, treated the casualties and took them to Pok Oi Hospital. Local reports said the injured comprised four men and two women who suffered neck injuries. None of the injuries was described as life-threatening.

The Transport Department implemented single-lane two-way traffic control in the vicinity while the road was cleared. Congestion built up on the affected section of Castle Peak Road. Police are investigating the cause of the collision.

zh.headline: 青山公路潭尾段貨車小巴相撞六人受傷
zh.dek: 一輛重型貨車與一輛專線小巴星期四下午約四時半在元朗青山公路潭尾段近壆圍相撞，六人頸部受傷送往博愛醫院。
body: 星期四下午，一輛重型貨車與一輛綠色專線小巴在元朗青山公路潭尾段往元朗方向近壆圍位置相撞，造成六人受傷。
警方約下午四時半接報，消防及救護人員到場為傷者包紮，其後將四人及兩名女子送往博愛醫院治理，傷勢均為頸部不適，暫無人有生命危險。
運輸署在現場實施單線雙程行車措施，青山公路潭尾段一度出現擠塞。警方正調查意外原因。
